## What lives here
The controlled vocabulary (ontology): schemes, concepts, annotations of agents, workflows, tools and libraries, industry knowledge, matching and tagging, and the seed YAML.

## Conventions
Concept ids are dotted paths. Closed schemes refuse edits. `app/ontology/*` holds legacy import aliases of these modules.

## Entry points
`store.py`, `seed_loader.py`, `match.py` and `tagging.py`.
